features: 4K HD Video Action Camera: This body camera features 4K high-definition recording, perfectly capturing every memorable moment. Whether documenting natural landscapes, outdoor activities, or precious times with family and pets, it delivers clear, easily shareable videos. The built-in microphone ensures videos are accompanied by high-fidelity audio, making your memories truly immersive and worth sharing. Note: Landscape orientation shoot only.

Tiny Thumb Size & Lightweight: The mini body camera is incredibly compact, with a volume even smaller than a thumb and weighing only 1.38 ounces (42 grams). It is nearly imperceptible when worn, seamlessly blending with the body. Whether for shooting video blogs, travel documentation, or capturing life’s moments, it is an ideal choice.

Hands-Free POV Camera & Wearable Design: This vlogging camera adopts a magnetic design and comes with a magnetic clip, allowing for quick attachment to your chest in just one second. (Not suitable for pacemaker users.) Alternatively, you can clip this body cam onto a hat. The magnetic hat clip supports 360° rotation and angle adjustment, enabling effortless changes in shooting perspective while freeing your hands for first-person video creation.Multiple mounting options suit scenarios like cycling, hiking, fishing, and boating.

32GB Storage: Comes with a 32GB memory card. It can store a large number of videos or photos to use the space more efficiently; you can also use an additional memory card (up to 128GB) to expand the space. This sports camera is equipped with a 1.47 inch high-definition display so you can instantly check and adjust the recording effects. You can simply use the screen to make sure every shot is recorded to make your videos stand out.

Anywhere Mount: This POV camera is equipped with a 180° magnetic hat clip and a magnetic pendant, allowing it to adhere to magnetic surfaces. The camera frame features a 1/4-inch screw hole, making it compatible with various tripods to suit different shooting scenarios (tripod sold separately). When paired with other accessories, it can also be mounted on bicycles, helmets, and surfboards. All necessary accessories are included in the package. Not only can you explore the world from your baby’s perspective, but you can also capture their vivid expressions.

Long Battery Life: This bodycam supports recording while charging, significantly extending shooting time. The thumb-sized camera can continuously record for up to 100 minutes in 4K at 30fps. With one‐click recording, you can instantly capture memorable moments.
